label: One classical GOD_4; two GOD_4 with one classical; two classical GOD_4
paraphrase: Premise-free finite models on the case signature, whose other fields are empty and assert nothing historical or religious. Nonvacuity: where exactly one thing is GOD_4 and has the classical attributes, both UniqueClassicalGodExists and GodHasClassicalAttributes hold. Omission of uniqueness: where two things are GOD_4 and only one has the classical attributes, some GOD_4 has them, yet not every GOD_4 does and the unique-GOD_4 premise fails. Strictness: where two things are GOD_4 and both have the classical attributes, every GOD_4 has them, yet the unique-GOD_4 premise fails.
